data.name: Aytan
data.gender_notes: Aytan is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aytan refers to the night gazer, one who stays up late to observe the stars and seek guidance from the heavens. It is derived from the Arabic word 'a'tana', which means 'to look, observe, or watch'. In Islamic tradition, this behavior is encouraged as a way to connect with Allah and gain insight into the divine. The name Aytan carries the meaning “Night gazing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aytan usually hope their child will grow to embody night gazing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Aytan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Night gazing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aytan total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
